basic_profile.bio: Based in New York City, I am a software consultant specializing in enterprise resource planning systems, particularly SAP. I have a deep passion for classical Chinese literature, which I explore during my downtime. I enjoy participating in NYC-based wedding planning communities as I recently got engaged. My online hours are typically in the evenings after work and on weekends. I work in a fast-paced environment, often traveling for client meetings. I love gaming as a stress reliever, particularly enjoying strategic shooters like Rainbow Six Siege.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My expertise in SAP comes from both formal training and hands-on experience during numerous implementation projects. Additionally, I am self-taught in classical Chinese through online courses and literature.
